text: {"lessons":["Ten periods of mixed returns are too little evidence to infer that my approach is succeeding or failing; I should focus on long-term goals rather than recent fluctuations.","I should not let the urge to avoid admitting a mistake keep me invested in a stock: assess each holding on its future prospects and its contribution to the portfolio, not whether it is above my cost basis.","Infrequent trading can help me avoid impulsive reactions, but I should periodically check diversification and risk so that doing nothing remains a deliberate choice."]}
